additional_info.subject: RE: ID0409530-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312569868/07] reboots in loop before reaching the loading screen CRM:00579001540
additional_info.body:
Hello Franck,
Greetings of the day!
With reference to trailing mail, customer
Failed to initialize the terminal. Charger reboots in a loop before reaching the loading screen.
Upon investigation, we found that the SCB is offline and was last online on 22/01/2025. Since the SCB is offline, we are unable to perform remote diagnostics
.
Please check the router and SIM card for any issues.
There is an existing case (ID0404912) with you, where it was suggested to check the router and SIM card. Have you taken any action on this?
Additionally, since the charger reboots in a loop, please check at what percentage it reboots.
Kindly provide us with a picture of the LEDs on KF1 during booting.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut

additional_info.subject: Notes for L2
additional_info.body:
Background:
SCB is offline since 1 month. RC was already informed to check Router and SIM. But not sure, if any action is taken by Frank Le Gal on this. Already asked him to confirm the same.
AI:
It will depend on RC's reply. If no site intervention was carried out, kindly ask him to check Router and sim. Also need to check if PLC is in error mode while charger is booting. If yes, we can try flashing Cfast or restore config. If still issue persist, then need to check further if there is any issue with KF1 (Discuss with L3 if needed)
Note:
Charger is Out of warranty. Kindly inform the same to RC, in next response from our side.
